channel.title: Open-Source on Junho Lee
channel.description: Recent content in Open-Source on Junho Lee

item.title: KAIST MLP Releases KORMo-Web, a Local Korean Web GUI Agent
item.description: KAIST MLP released KORMo-Web, a local web GUI agent tailored for Korean web environments, along with training datasets, evaluation benchmarks, and a Chrome extension.

item.title: ClamDown: Run Coding Agents Safely on MacBooks with the Lid Closed
item.description: ClamDown is an open-source menu bar app that manages CPU temperatures and battery levels to safely run coding agents while your MacBook lid is closed.

item.title: Google's Open-Source Elephant-Goldfish Model Plugin for AI Software Design
item.description: Google open-sourced its internal Elephant-Goldfish Model (EGM) plugin under Apache 2.0, pairing a no-code long-horizon architect session with stateless adversarial reviewers.

item.title: rea-video: Open-Source Shot-by-Shot Video Reverse Engineering
item.description: rea-video breaks down live-action, AI-generated, 3D, and motion-graphics videos frame by frame into camera setups, prompts, audio cues, and replication blueprints.

item.title: Handy: Dictating AI Prompts Directly at Your Cursor on macOS
item.description: Handy is a free open-source macOS speech-to-text app that inserts dictated text right at the cursor, using Whisper Large v3 locally while keeping data boundaries clear.

item.title: Filee: A Free Local Converter Supporting 180 File Formats on Your PC
item.description: Filee is a free open-source desktop converter that handles 180 file formats locally via drag-and-drop and CLI folder watching without cloud uploads.

item.title: Analyzing REA: AI Agent-Driven Reverse Engineering and Code Recovery
item.description: Open-source tool REA connects AI agents via MCP to inspect binaries and app internals locally, recovering byte-accurate C source code.

item.title: Running Multiple AI Coding Agents as One Team with OpenRig
item.description: OpenRig lets developers define multiple AI coding agents like Claude Code and Codex in YAML and coordinate them as a persistent team.

item.title: Thursday: Open-Source Voice Assistant Backed by Background AI Bots
item.description: Thursday separates live voice conversation on GPT-Live 1 from background bots that run browser, shell, and file tasks asynchronously on your local machine.

item.title: Google RRSI: Recursive Self-Improvement for AI Agent Harnesses
item.description: Google Research’s Apache 2.0 RRSI framework freezes LLM weights and recursively optimizes agent harnesses via dual regularization and Git worktrees.

item.title: Kev: Open-Source Multi-Question Decision Models Built on Qwen3.5
item.description: Created by Turborepo founder Jared Palmer, Kev reproduces Jev’s isolated single-pass multi-question scoring in Apache 2.0 Qwen3.5 models from 0.8B to 9B.

item.title: Shopify Tangle: Visual Editing and Execution Caching for ML Pipelines
item.description: Shopify’s open-source Tangle tool lets teams build containerized ML pipelines visually, share workflows, and cache intermediate outputs across runs.

item.title: OpenKB: Turning Scattered Documents into a Connected Local AI Wiki
item.description: OpenKB compiles local documents into an interlinked AI wiki using PageIndex tree indexing without a vector database.

item.title: Prime Agent: Solving Context Bloat in Long-Running Coding Agents with RLM
item.description: Prime Agent replaces static file-reading tools with a persistent IPython REPL and Recursive Language Model architecture for multi-hour coding sessions.

item.title: MatrAIx: 8.3B Persona Design vs. the Released 1M Evaluation Coreset
item.description: Separating MatrAIx’s 8.3B persona design scale from its 1M public coreset, four evaluation environments, and what its 91.5% score actually measures.

item.title: Tencent Team Memory 2.0: Four Shared Memory Assets for Agents
item.description: Tencent’s Team Memory 2.0 organizes chats, workflows, docs, and code into Chat Memory, Skill, LLM-Wiki, and Code-Graph for team-wide agent reuse.

item.title: Krafton Open-Sources 21B Voice Foundation Model A.X K2 Raon-Speech
item.description: Krafton released A.X K2 Raon-Speech on Hugging Face, combining SK Telecom’s A.X K2 language model with a custom speech encoder and codec in a 21B open model.

item.title: OmniRoute: Open-Source Gateway Unifying Hundreds of Free AI Models
item.description: OmniRoute exposes 268+ providers and 500+ AI models behind a single local endpoint with automatic quota failover, 18 routing strategies, and up to 95% token compression.

item.title: StackRender: Open-Source Database Schema Design and Automation Tool
item.description: StackRender is an open-source visual schema designer supporting PostgreSQL, MySQL, foreign key cycle detection, index recommendations, and AI-assisted generation.

item.title: Sharpening Agent Domain Skills with the claude-skills Library
item.description: Explore claude-skills, an open-source library of 355 skills and 602 Python tools compatible with 13 AI coding tools, built with progressive disclosure and security auditing.

item.title: Major Update to 160K-Star Open-Source Library prompts.chat
item.description: Open-source prompt repository prompts.chat (160K+ GitHub stars) expands to over 2,000 prompts and adds 63 AI agent skills, 13 prompt chains, and a Claude Code plugin.

item.title: Skills for Design Engineers: Teaching AI Agents Apple-Caliber UI Motion
item.description: Emil Kowalski’s open-source skill pack gives coding agents like Claude Code and Codex concrete checklists and motion rules for fluid, Apple-grade web interfaces.

item.title: Microsoft Flint: An Intermediate Visualization Language for AI Agents
item.description: Microsoft open-sourced Flint, a concise chart specification language designed so both AI agents and humans can generate and edit visualizations reliably.

item.title: OfficeCLI: Let AI Agents Edit Office Documents Without Microsoft Office
item.description: OfficeCLI is a single-binary open-source CLI tool that lets AI agents create, inspect, and edit Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files without installing Microsoft Office.

item.title: MaxKB: An Open-Source Agent Platform Unifying RAG and Workflows
item.description: MaxKB combines RAG pipelines, visual agent workflows, and MCP tool integration on top of PostgreSQL and pgvector without requiring a separate vector database.

item.title: Mac Whisper: On-Device Push-to-Talk Voice Dictation via the Fn Key
item.description: Mac Whisper is an open-source macOS dictation tool triggered by holding the Fn key, with version 0.0.4 cutting CPU overhead and adding optional LLM cleanup.

item.title: Prism Insight: Open-Source Multi-Agent Stock Analysis and Trading Architecture
item.description: Prism Insight wires 13+ AI agents from stock screening and PDF reports to automated brokerage orders. Examine its multi-agent workflow design and operational risks.

item.title: MemPalace: A Local Open-Source Hierarchical Memory System for AI
item.description: MemPalace organizes local AI memory into hierarchical Wings, Rooms, and Drawers on top of Python and ChromaDB, reaching up to 98.4% hybrid retrieval accuracy.

item.title: opendataloader-pdf: Hybrid Open-Source PDF Parsing for RAG Pipelines
item.description: opendataloader-pdf pairs fast local parsing with an AI hybrid backend to reach 92.8% table accuracy while generating Tagged PDFs for accessibility compliance.

item.title: Building a Multi-Agent Value Investing System with Claude Code
item.description: AI Berkshire encodes classic value-investing frameworks into Claude Code commands, using adversarial multi-agent debate and Python verification to curb LLM bias.

item.title: agentdir: Safe Read-Only Virtual Workspaces for AI Agents
item.description: Built in Rust, agentdir projects scattered local files into clean read-only Copy-on-Write directory trees so AI agents work fast without touching originals.

item.title: AI Slide Decks: Why 80% Is Instant and the Last 20% Is Hard
item.description: AI presentation generators produce 80% drafts in seconds, but closing the final 20% for real meetings takes targeted editing tools like slides-grab and Snapdeck.

item.title: Connecting Local LLMs and Managing Profiles in Codex CLI OSS Mode
item.description: How to wire Ollama or LM Studio into Codex CLI OSS mode using the responses wire API and standalone per-profile config files in v0.134.0+.

item.title: free-router: Terminal CLI That Routes Coding Agents to Fast Free Models
item.description: free-router pings free AI endpoints across NVIDIA NIM and OpenRouter every 2 seconds and wires the lowest-latency model into coding agents.

item.title: Inside MacPilot: Browser-Based Mac Trackpad, Keyboard, and Macro Deck
item.description: How the open-source MacPilot app turns any mobile browser into a wireless Mac trackpad, keyboard, and Stream Deck using NWListener and CGEvent.

item.title: open-code-review: High-Precision Hybrid AI Code Review at Scale
item.description: An open-source AI code review tool from a global tech company pairs deterministic static analysis with LLM agents to cut false positives and use 9x fewer tokens.

item.title: LLM Wiki: A Desktop Knowledge Base Built on Karpathy's Wiki Pattern
item.description: LLM Wiki implements Andrej Karpathy’s incremental wiki pattern as a desktop app, turning raw documents into a persistent knowledge graph.

item.title: Omnigent: Open-Source Meta-Harness for Orchestrating AI Agents
item.description: Omnigent unifies coding and custom AI agents into shared, policy-controlled sessions with cross-device sync and cloud sandboxes.

item.title: Measuring Brand Visibility in LLM Search with Open-Source geobench
item.description: Open-source toolkit geobench measures Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) metrics including Hit Rate, MRR, Share of Voice, and Surface Fidelity.

item.title: How Alibaba's Open-Source AI Code Reviewer OCR Separates Code from LLM Judgment
item.description: Validated over two years at Alibaba, open-source code reviewer OCR pairs deterministic file bundling and line validation with LLM judgment.

item.title: OpenDesign: A Workspace for Generating Designs with Local Coding Agents
item.description: OpenDesign connects local coding agents and BYOK API keys to design systems, separating free local workflows from paid hosted model credits.

item.title: How Decades of Document Parsing Tech Topped GitHub Trending
item.description: A Korean software company hit #1 on GitHub Trending by open-sourcing its PDF extraction engine instead of selling a monolithic office suite.

item.title: macshot: A Native Swift Open-Source Screenshot Tool for macOS
item.description: Built with native Swift and AppKit instead of Electron, macshot brings 8MB memory usage, one-click PII redaction, OCR, and scrolling capture to macOS.

item.title: OpenDocuments: Local RAG Across Scattered Team Knowledge
item.description: An open-source on-premise RAG platform that connects docs across Notion, GitHub, and S3 to local LLMs without external API calls.

item.title: Self-Hosting Team RAG with OpenDocuments, SQLite, and LanceDB
item.description: OpenDocuments unifies scattered docs from Notion, GitHub, and S3 into a local Ollama-backed RAG stack built on TypeScript, SQLite, and LanceDB.
